subject: the 33 held-out incumbents the second-round blind read marked not right, re-read against one codified rule set
reader: coordinating session, 2026-11-23, at the lead's request to test whether they are failures or readings of unsettled rules
finding: the two readings of the same names disagree on 17 of the 33 (the reference set called them sound or a definition fault); the disagreements trace to rules that leave the call open, not to the names

rules.identity: A word that changes the number a quantity takes belongs in the name: what is counted or carried (energy versus number, ions versus neutrals, equivalent electrons versus particles), how it is measured when that changes the value (apparent versus thermodynamic temperature), and which quantity a rate or time belongs to.
rules.specification: Where and how a quantity is evaluated (a location such as the midplane, a reconstruction context, a component sub-unit, the species pair of a collisionality) belongs in the definition, unless two catalog names would otherwise denote the same words; then the name carries the least that separates them.
rules.owner: A centre, centroid, axis or similar locus names its owner unless the term is unique in the catalog.
rules.parent: A generic parent name is right when it names the general quantity its children specialise; being general is not a multiplicity defect.
rules.conventional_term: A term with a settled meaning (neutron flux as a number flux, parity, weight, radius of a coil) is used only with that meaning.
rules.transfer: A transfer between two populations names both donor and recipient; the grammar has no form for this today.
rules.one_name: One quantity has one name; a repaired name that collides with an existing one marks a duplicate to retire, not a repair to refuse.
